_rubric.2: Direct evidence. A reviewer would point at this bullet to say the requirement is met.
_rubric.1: Partial or adjacent. Related work, or the right domain but the wrong specific claim. Also: a job title that asserts the skill without demonstrating it.
_guidance: Judge the bullet against THIS requirement only, not overall candidate quality.
Do not reward keyword overlap that carries no substantive claim.
When torn between 1 and 2, ask: would a hiring manager accept this bullet alone as proof? If no, it is a 1.
Label every (requirement, bullet) pair. An omitted pair is scored 0 and is indistinguishable from a deliberate 0.
